title: Tiny, cute avocado
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs></defs>
  <!-- shadow/glow base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='22' ry='5' fill='#1d2b1f'/>
  <!-- outer avocado body: bumpy pear shape -->
  <path d='M50 12 C36 12 24 28 24 46 C24 64 32 86 50 86 C68 86 76 64 76 46 C76 28 64 12 50 12 Z' fill='#3f7d2e'/>
  <!-- body highlight side -->
  <path d='M50 12 C36 12 24 28 24 46 C24 64 32 86 50 86 C56 86 60 80 62 72 C52 70 44 60 44 44 C44 30 50 18 58 14 C55 12 52 12 50 12 Z' fill='#54a03a'/>
  <!-- bumpy texture dots -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='40' r='2.2' fill='#2e5f21'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='30' r='1.8' fill='#2e5f21'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='55' r='2' fill='#2e5f21'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='68' r='2.2' fill='#2e5f21'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='38' r='2' fill='#2e5f21'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='56' r='2.2' fill='#2e5f21'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='70' r='1.8' fill='#2e5f21'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='78' r='2' fill='#2e5f21'/>
  <!-- cut face revealing inside, an oval window -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='18' ry='24' fill='#c9e86b'/>
  <!-- inner lighter rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='18' ry='24' fill='none' stroke='#eaf6a8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- pit, warm brown-purple (lit) -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='9' fill='#8a5a3c'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='9' fill='none' stroke='#b07a52' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='55' r='2.2' fill='#c99a72'/>
  <!-- little cute eyes on the cut face -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='44' r='2' fill='#2f4a10'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='44' r='2' fill='#2f4a10'/>
  <circle cx='43.6' cy='43.3' r='0.7' fill='#f4ffd0'/>
  <circle cx='57.6' cy='43.3' r='0.7' fill='#f4ffd0'/>
  <!-- tiny smile -->
  <path d='M46 48 Q50 51 54 48' fill='none' stroke='#2f4a10' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='49' r='2' fill='#f2a0a0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='49' r='2' fill='#f2a0a0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- little leaf sprout on top -->
  <path d='M50 12 C50 6 54 3 58 4 C56 8 54 10 50 12 Z' fill='#7ec850'/>
  <path d='M50 12 C50 6 46 3 42 4 C44 8 46 10 50 12 Z' fill='#9be070'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='12' x2='50' y2='7' stroke='#5a9a34' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
